body: Repair update before recut: all three blockers now have discriminating evidence in the isolated clone. F1 uses independent proxy halos plus direct dashes and a real browser composite court on both Atlas and Codex; deliberately removing the halo fails exactly those checks. F2 carries MarkId and FragmentId through a checked one-to-one rendered-target index and rejects phantom, partial, duplicate, and identity-mismatched targets. F3 uses an explicitly labelled Diagnostic plate built from a real paginated Codex fragment and exercises lowering, DOM injection, CSS, truthful ARIA/labels, activation through the visible ancestor, and direct restoration without claiming that WOG naturally produces Codex ViaAncestor. The full compileAll testAll scalafmtCheckAll app/fastLinkJS gate and normal browser smoke are green; orphan, horizon, and composite mutations fail as intended. I am cutting a replacement immutable candidate now; no landing is implied.
